title: 11. DROP a table
prompt:
DROP TABLE removes a whole table, not just its rows.

Remove the houses table. Leave students in place.

The check runs afterwards: houses_left should be 0 and students_left should be 1.
effectQuery: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(name) = 'houses' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS houses_left, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(name) = 'students' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS students_left FROM sqlite_schema WHERE type = 'table' AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%'
